label: Screen OCR Multi-Machine DB
info:
Multi-Machine Screen OCR Data Receiver, Verification & Database Logger.
Supports both POST (push reading) and GET (verify readings, live status, and audit logs).

name: === POST APIS: RECEIVE OCR READINGS ===
info:
Machines post readings here:
POST /api/screen-ocr
Payload:
{
  "machine_name": "MC-04",
  "line_name": "Line-01",
  "value": "150",
  "previous_value": "140",
  "timestamp": "2026-09-06 23:40:00"
}

name: Validate, Cache & Prepare Data
NOTE: MySQL Configuration (Optional)
info:
To connect your MySQL / MariaDB:
1. Double-click DB node
2. Set Host, Port, User, Password, Database
3. Click Update -> Deploy

name: === GET APIS: VERIFY DATA & AUDIT FOR MISSED READINGS ===
info:
GET APIs allow verifying that no data is missed:
1. GET /api/screen-ocr/verify -> Instant audit check (total count, earliest, latest, zero missing)
2. GET /api/screen-ocr/status -> Live status of all reporting machines
3. GET /api/screen-ocr/logs -> Recent historical readings

=== MYSQL SELECT QUERY APIS: DIRECT DATABASE AUDIT & CHECK ===
info:
Direct MySQL SELECT Queries to verify stored vs missing records:
1. GET /api/screen-ocr/db-verify -> Runs SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(captured_at) from machine_ocr_logs
2. GET /api/screen-ocr/db-logs -> Runs SELECT * FROM machine_ocr_logs ORDER BY id DESC
